proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2020`, PDF pages 26-30 of the FY2020 annual town report -- the Town Accountant's schedule. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each of the five pages, so there is no text layer; each page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of about 1060x1400 px (~125 dpi) read at 1.9x in two halves. FIVE MONEY COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER: APPROPRIATED FORWARD, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, TOTAL EXPENDED, TOTAL ENCUMBERED, BALANCE TO REVENUE, plus a narrow flag column carrying `fwd`, `srt` or `rft`. 83 DEPARTMENTS, 416 ASSERTIONS, ALL CLOSING TO THE CENT. Per department: the detail lines add to the printed subtotal in each of the four columns they carry, and the subtotal states available - expended - encumbered = balance to revenue (81 of 83 print a balance; the two TRANSFERS TO OTHER FUNDS rows leave it blank, so nothing asserts it there). Across the run: all five columns add down to the printed GRAND TOTAL of $43,104,912.84 / $43,104,912.84 / $41,024,362.43 / $838,486.09 / $1,242,064.32. AND THE PAGE'S OWN FOOTER IS THREE MORE INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES, proved in `fy2020-p26-appropriations-carryforward.csv`: `fwd - forward from FY 2019 $283,034.02`, `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $17,834.74` and `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer $16,890.00` are the sums of the flag lines scattered through the schedule, and each closes exactly. A `fwd` LINE IS A LINE OF THE COLUMN, not an annotation: every department's printed subtotal includes its flag lines. THIS SETTLES THE RUN. `notes/HANDOFF-ANNUAL-REPORTS.md` recorded the accountant's schedule as the closest FY2020 reconciliation at +$33,741 on $43.1M with nothing tying to the cent; the printed APPROPRIATED FORWARD total is $43,104,912.84 and the 83 departments foot to it exactly.
